# Listings in Quarto

## What Are Quarto Listings?

Quarto Listings allow users to organize and display collections of content, such as projects, articles, and reports.

Listings make it easier for visitors to explore different sections of a website.

## Benefits of Quarto Listings

-   Organize projects in one place.
-   Make website navigation easier.
-   Display project titles and descriptions.
-   Automatically update listings when new content is added.
-   Create a more professional portfolio.

## How I Can Use Listings in My Portfolio

As a Digital Marketing graduate student, I can use Quarto Listings to showcase my academic projects and technical skills.

Examples include:

-   MSDM Capstone Project
-   Marketing Analytics Projects
-   SQL and R Assignments

## Example: Quarto Listing Configuration

The following YAML code shows how to create a listing in Quarto:

``` yaml
listing:
  contents: projects
  type: grid
  sort: "date desc"
```

This configuration displays project pages from a folder named `projects` in a grid layout, sorted by date.

## Conclusion

Quarto Listings provide an effective way to organize and present academic work. They can help make my digital marketing portfolio easier to navigate and maintain.
